description: Rewrites only immediate say/says/said/saying with object-pronoun complements from with to to, with a tight tail allowlist.
fp_risk_note: High risk. With is valid in parentheticals, absolute constructions, questions, manner phrases, and non-calque structures. Rebuilt v1 only rewrites say/says/said/saying with immediate with plus object pronoun, blocks fronted what/which questions and intervening objects, and allows only sentence end, punctuation boundary, or a small enumerated time/place tail.

positive.input: I want to say with you.
positive.expectedCorrection: I want to say to you.
positive.notes: Immediate say with object-pronoun complement at sentence end.
Allows enumerated safe time tail: yesterday.

positive.input: He says with her every day.
positive.expectedCorrection: He says to her every day.
positive.notes: Allows enumerated safe frequency tail: every day.

positive.input: They are saying with us now.
positive.expectedCorrection: They are saying to us now.
positive.notes: Allows progressive saying with immediate object pronoun and safe now tail.

positive.input: Please say with them after class.
positive.expectedCorrection: Please say to them after class.

positive.input: I said with him at 5 PM.
positive.expectedCorrection: I said to him at 5 PM.

negative.input: Say it with me.
negative.expectedCorrection: Say it with me.
negative.notes: Intervening object makes with a non-immediate complement.

negative.input: She said the truth with him.
negative.expectedCorrection: She said the truth with him.
negative.notes: Intervening object blocks the rule.

negative.input: I would say, with him, that it is wrong.
negative.expectedCorrection: I would say, with him, that it is wrong.
negative.notes: Comma immediately before with marks parenthetical use.

negative.input: What are you saying with them?
negative.expectedCorrection: What are you saying with them?
negative.notes: Fronted what-question is blocked.

negative.input: Which sentence are you saying with them?
negative.expectedCorrection: Which sentence are you saying with them?
negative.notes: Fronted which-question is blocked.

negative.input: She said with him beside me.
negative.expectedCorrection: She said with him beside me.
negative.notes: Non-allowlisted prepositional/adverbial tail blocks the rule.

negative.input: She said with him present.
negative.expectedCorrection: She said with him present.
negative.notes: Adjective tail after pronoun blocks the rule.

negative.input: She said with him gone.
negative.expectedCorrection: She said with him gone.

negative.input: They said with us there.
negative.expectedCorrection: They said with us there.
negative.notes: Unlisted location tail blocks the rule.

negative.input: She said with him sitting near me.
negative.expectedCorrection: She said with him sitting near me.
negative.notes: Participle tail blocks the rule.

negative.input: She said with him in the room.
negative.expectedCorrection: She said with him in the room.
negative.notes: Prepositional tail blocks the rule.

negative.input: She said with him by my side.
negative.expectedCorrection: She said with him by my side.
negative.notes: Prepositional tail blocks the rule.

negative.input: She said with me that he was late.
negative.expectedCorrection: She said with me that he was late.

negative.expectedCorrection: She said with him who was beside me.

negative.expectedCorrection: She said with him because he asked.
